description: Property panel for the selected table, with controls for width, alignment, cell padding, background color, and border style. Clones the layout and raises LayoutChanged on each edit.

parameters.name: TestIdRoot
parameters.description: Base string for this panel's data-testid attributes. Defaults to document-table-properties.

parameters.name: ShortSet
parameters.description: The short set of a phone (decision G2): only the table alignment. The width, the cell padding, the background and the border stay for a tablet and up. Defaults to false (the full panel).
